# Makoba

> > Makoba is India's premier online destination for luxury fountain pens, limited edition gift sets, premium notebooks, and curated stationery collections from world-renowned brands.

Makoba specializes in high-end writing instruments and stationery, offering an extensive catalog of premium pens from international luxury brands like Aurora, Cross, Diplomat, and Caran d'Ache, alongside exclusive gift sets, notebooks, and fountain pen inks. The platform caters to discerning customers seeking limited edition collections and artisanal writing products.

## Luxury Fountain Pen Collections

- [AP Limited Edition Pens](https://makoba.com/collections/ap-limited-editions): AP limited edition luxury fountain pens with handcrafted Maki-e lacquer art
- [Aurora Pens & Ink Bottles](https://makoba.com/collections/aurora): Aurora Italian premium fountain pens and limited edition ink bottles
- [Caran d'Ache Pens Ink & Pencils](https://makoba.com/collections/caran-dache): Caran d'Ache luxury pens, colored pencils and ink bottles collection
- [Cross Pens](https://makoba.com/collections/cross): Cross iconic luxury pens including Peerless, Bailey and Beverly collections
- [Diplomat Pens](https://makoba.com/collections/diplomat): Diplomat German-made luxury fountain pens and ball pens collection
- [Delta Pens](https://makoba.com/collections/delta): Delta limited edition luxury fountain pens with precision craftsmanship
- [Conklin Pens](https://makoba.com/collections/conklin): Conklin premium fountain pens including Hippocrates and Duragraph models
- [Click Pens](https://makoba.com/collections/click-1): Click brand luxury fountain pens with retro acrylic and renaissance designs
- [Benu Pens](https://makoba.com/collections/benu): Benu limited edition hand-painted fountain pens and ink accessories
- [Arista Pens](https://makoba.com/collections/arista): Arista fountain pens, ball pens and leatherite pen holder accessories

## Premium Notebooks & Planners

- [Clairefontaine Notebooks](https://makoba.com/collections/clairefontaine): Clairefontaine premium threadbound notebooks with dotted and squared pages
- [Apica Notebooks](https://makoba.com/collections/apica): Apica CD notebooks in multiple sizes and color variants
- [7mm Collection](https://makoba.com/collections/7mm): 7mm collection of notepads, planners and daily stationery products
- [Dexter Notebooks](https://makoba.com/collections/dexter-notebooks): Dexter premium erasable reusable eco-friendly A5 notebooks
- [Cuir Ally Notebooks](https://makoba.com/collections/cuir-ally): Cuir Ally eco-friendly erasable reusable notebooks and stationery

## Fountain Pen Inks

- [Diamine Inks](https://makoba.com/collections/diamine): Diamine fountain pen inks with chameleon and sheen color options
- [Colorverse Ink Bottles](https://makoba.com/collections/colorverse): Colorverse space-themed limited edition fountain pen ink bottles
